page.layout: One title page. Title block at top, centred. Woodcut engraving with banderole text in the centre. Imprint below the engraving, centred. A library stamp at the left edge and handwritten marks are not transcribed.
page.notes: The library stamp ("STADTBIBLIOTHEK ZÜRICH") at the left edge is not transcribed. The handwritten red-brown marks are not transcribed: a scribble at the left margin, an overwritten "ias" after "Vuolph", and a mark over the "C" of "XCIII". The imprint may read "Vuolphius" with the last letters partly covered by the handwriting, so "Vuolph[?]ius" is uncertain. The engraving's base letters "F.S.A." and "H.CA." are read as a monogram or signature, and the stains in the engraving centre are not printed text. The reading of "XCIII" is partly obscured by the handwritten mark. No page number or running head is printed.
